title: Gold-driven days against dollar-driven days: continuation and fade

rule.signal: XAU/USD, XAU/EUR, XAU/GBP daily returns each in units of the sd of its own 20 returns before the day; gold-driven = all three beyond 0.5 the same way; dollar-driven up = USD > 0.5, EUR and GBP < 0
rule.costs: $0.60 a trade + nights() x FIN.xau.long on buys
rule.excess: net R minus the mean net R of the same trade on every eligible day of the window

tests.what: gold-driven up day (up > 0.5 sd in USD, EUR and GBP): buy, hold 3 days (primary)
gold-driven down day (down > 0.5 sd in USD, EUR and GBP): sell, hold 3 days
dollar-driven up day (up > 0.5 sd in USD, down in EUR and GBP): sell (fade), hold 3 days
